name: ASXL transcriptional regulator 2
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II
positive regulation of fat cell differentiation

function.text: ASXL2 encodes putative Polycomb group protein ASXL2. Annotated molecular activities include chromatin binding and peroxisome proliferator activated receptor binding. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of fat cell differentiation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to syndromic intellectual disability (autosomal dominant); Shashi-Pena syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic ASXL2 mutations have been reported in several cancer types, including breast, bladder, pancreatic, ovarian, prostate, and hematologic tumors.
